issues: BLOCKER: The revert helper (heredoc in batch-10.sh) runs `systemctl reload systemd-journald` under `set -euo pipefail`. I believe systemd-journald.service has no ExecReload, so the reload would fail with 'Job type reload is not applicable'. I did not verify this on Johnny, so please check it with `systemctl cat systemd-journald | grep -i ExecReload`. If it fails, the helper exits before `rm -f "$TAR"` and before printing REVERTED. The tar then stays, and the next PASTE 1 hits STOP-tar-exists. This helper is written today, even though the run will stop at STOP-collector-514. The ERR trap would also call the broken helper on any later set -e failure. Fix: make it non-fatal, for example `systemctl reload systemd-journald || systemctl try-restart systemd-journald || true`. The merged value is identical to the vendor one, so no reload is needed. Apply the same fix to PASTE 2 if it ever calls it, and to the standalone rollback block in batch-10.md. A failed reload there would also skip the rsyslog line, and the block has no `set -e`.

BLOCKER: In the apply path, `systemctl reload systemd-journald` after writing the 61 drop-in has the same risk. If the reload fails, set -e aborts after the drop-in and rsyslog forwarder are already written, and BATCH10-SSH-DONE never prints. Make it non-fatal, or drop it. The existing `systemd-analyze cat-config ... ForwardToSyslog=yes` check already verifies the setting.

Verified OK, no change needed: the script reaches the TCP 514 probe after the GRUB and module steps. It prints STOP-collector-514, exits 1, and writes neither the rsyslog nor the journald drop-in. It uses the documented IP 192.168.50.211 with TCP/omfwd and falls back with the hostname in a comment. There is no apt or dpkg. Every md paste block starts with `# RUNS ON:`. GRUB 1.4.1 and 3.2.7 are unchanged.

Note (non-blocking): STOP-collector-514 exits 1 after GRUB-OK has printed and the GRUB and module changes are already applied. The md says this, but the Expect line should say the first run today ends in STOP-collector-514 and not BATCH10-SSH-DONE. AJ should not treat that as a rollback trigger.

Note (non-blocking): the md says `ip neigh` showed STALE, while the live fact given for this review is REACHABLE. This is cosmetic. Also, STOP-revert-old tells AJ to run the full revert, which undoes GRUB, just to refresh the helper. This is heavy but safe.
